page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top centre. Below it a full-width title block (level 1 heading with two lines of Latin), then an italic verse stanza set as a block, then a second title "IN LVPVM." with italic verse, then a catchword-like line "DE" at lower right. No margin notes.

main_text.l: anno Domini clɔ Iɔ xxxiv, quum

l.i: FLacce, tibi quādoq; bonus dormitat Homerus
Sed num propterea cacus Homerus erat?
Immo oculis captus quinam credatur Homerus
Quem sequitur Ꝯatum catera turba ducem
Illius sed enim splendorem longa Ꝯetustas
Tu Melior, donec, fato meliore, renato
Dux ipsi fieres, Volmare magne, duci.
Mox Ꝯero Ꝯt tibi cœna sumpta mecum,
Qui factum hoc, Lupe, tam cito Ꝯt iuberes
Cœnatus, Lupe, non eras apud te.

page.notes: Running head and page number as printed; the scan shows no page number. The lower-right "DE" is treated as a catchword-like fragment.
